name: a link hiding a tab
why: A browser strips a tab from an address before it parses it, so the two segments here that read as broken text are '..' and '..' by the time it resolves them: https://github.com/evil/x. No segment reads as a dot segment literally, so the tab is the only thing that gives this away. (A newline does the same, and a fact carrying one is refused before its links are read at all: see backticks-across-a-blank-line.json.)
